checks.schema_interpolation_note: Schema-name interpolation for table-path qualification ('"schema_name".table_name') is the codebase-established pattern for schema-per-tenant scoping (same as DLQ, event store, retention policy). The interpolated value is a system-managed schema name from TenantProvisioning, not raw user input — it is not a SQL injection vector.

checks.risk_assessment: prefix is schema_name from TenantProvisioning.tenant_schemas() — a system-managed value, not user-controlled input. Realistic failure probability is low. Even if MatchError is raised: it occurs inside a Repo.transaction/fn callback (Ecto rolls back and re-raises), which is caught by poller.ex's try/rescue _ -> :ok for that schema iteration. No shared Poller process state is corrupted; no other tenant is affected.
checks.external_io_paths: All external I/O call sites (EventStore.append_platform_event, Dlq.enqueue, Repo.* calls) use explicit case pattern matching on {:ok,_}/{:error,_}. Rollback paths are explicit and correct.
checks.poller_isolation: Poller wraps each schema's run_cycle, sweep_gaps, and emit_lag_metrics in try/rescue — per design §2.2. One tenant failure cannot degrade other tenants' timer firing.

INV-9.reason: No outbound HTTP calls in this diff. Ordering subsystem is purely database I/O (Ecto/PostgreSQL).
